text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) dropped 12 points on Tuesday to stand at 1,382, the lowest since November 5, 1996.

Brokers reported Keoyang booked NOL Canopus 52,500 heavy grain NoPac to S.Korea Feb 11/20 at $12.00 while timecharter business included Captain George Tsangaris 61,349 dwt taken by Albatross for delivery Skaw early Feb for trip via Baltic redelivery Singapore/Japan range at $14,000 daily.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 15 to 5 points down in a turnover of 129 lots .
The Baltic Handysize Index was down six at 1,027 points.
